Name: Cat retexture - tabby white
Author: chevaloune
Description:
My first mod ever !

I wanted to create a new texture for the cat to look like my beloved cat Clochette who passed away long time ago (plus I didn't found any texture like that)

I am pretty satisfied with the result :)

To install :
- go to: 'Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals'
- Backup your 'cat.xnb'
- Replace the "cat.xnb" file by the one downloaded here
